MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: The trend champion is 'rf' with perfect trend correlation (1.0), while 'ONLY_CWT_rf' leads in seasonality capture (0.4254 correlation). 'ONLY_DWT_rf' achieves the lowest overall RMSE (117.42). High model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=43.59) and high seasonality variance suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition-aware combinations. Concept drift detected and autocorrelated residuals across most models indicate dynamic weighting with rolling training would be beneficial.
